formats.format_note: These exact retained fields are a legacy WQX2.2 profile. Current WQX3 exports require an explicit separate profile rather than header guessing.

identity.collisions: Preserve original identifiers and expose ambiguity. A source-row identity is always available; it is not automatically a cross-file scientific sample identity.

review_rules.requirement: Preserve original bytes, sheet/row, original header, lexical cell value and all unmapped columns; mapping is a saved interpretation, never a rewrite.
DetectedAboveMDL=N requires empty Result; preserve MDL/MRL separately. A blank or censored result is not zero.
A reported value strictly between MDL and MRL is Y with DNQ among QA codes. Equality or anomalous limits require explicit laboratory review.

MethodDetectionLimit=-88 represents not-determinable MDL for documented analyses including indicator bacteria. Preserve the sentinel and its meaning separately from numerical concentration or censoring bound.
Preserve original numerical strings and trailing zeros; parsed decimals can support comparisons but do not replace report text or precision.

Culture-based FIB laboratory duplicate sample type is LabDuplicate_Micro. MTF/tray methods use parent95%confidence interval; plate methods use Rlog and the stated method criterion. Culture laboratory RPD is left blank.
Field duplicates/triplicates are independent field collections, retain distinct sample types and parent matching; their RPD/RSD contract differs from culture laboratory duplicates.
Parent/child linkage retains exact station/project/collection datetime/agency/matrix/depth/unit fields plus original system/sample IDs. Do not invent ParentSampleID or EQuISSampleID.

Retain PCR_Blank, LabMethodBlank, PositiveControl, MatrixSpike1 and MatrixSpike2 with their stated matrices. Inhibition/PCR positive-control details not submitted to CEDEN may still be needed by the approved study and remain in full laboratory source/decision records.
CFU/100mL, MPN/100mL and molecular copy units remain distinct quantities. Any compatible dimensional scaling, recovery/dilution correction or pooling requires named source-bound method approval.

ResultSub and published rolling geomeans/counts/cutoff dates are separate publisher-derived fields. Keep original Result, ResultQualCode, MDL/RL and comments. Do not substitute publisher-derived values into the analytical input silently.
Legacy result qualifiers remain raw until their original code vocabulary and method are selected; absence of the CEDEN2 DetectedAboveMDL field must not generate a synthetic Y/N value.

Retain the original local date/time text and explicit source timezone if supplied. CEDEN2 time00:00 can mean unknown; a study timezone/unknown-time policy is a named decision, not a guessed UTC instant.

Wet/dry event assignment uses the selected study definition, antecedent rainfall/source and time window. A calendar date, legacy EventCode or WQP hydrologic label alone does not imply approved wet/dry membership.
Assign one of nine programme areas through an explicit source crosswalk or selected boundary edition with coordinate datum and boundary decisions. State RegionNumber is not a SCWP watershed-area ID.

FIB concentration is distinct from pathogen concentration, exposure dose and illness risk. Named approved model/input/output/version/units/assumptions and uncertainty decisions precede a scientific transformation.
Retain cost currency/year, capital/O&M, lifetime, discount assumptions and denominator with each measure; per-volume, per-length, per-area and per-risk-unit costs are not directly interchangeable.
Multiple analytes/methods/replicates are distinct observations. Match only on complete selected source identity; show exact duplicates and conflicting revisions for review rather than drop them.

Every disposition retains original row, issue code, selected action, reason, reviewer name/role/time, method-contract ID/version and predecessor decision. Correction and reintake preserve prior editions.
